Tumor Necrosis: Not identified. Other Tumor Features: Calcification of non-psammoma type. Marked stromal reaction. Psammoma bodies. Extensive squamous metaplasia. Tumor Location: Right lobe. The largest positive lymph node measures 0.9 cm and the largest. metastatic focus measures 0.7 cm. Comment: Extensive psammoma bodies are noted in the non-neoplastic thyroid. 3.
